lines.text: It’s show time! You will make your very own story with everything you learned.
Think of a story: who is in it, where it happens, and what happens.
Draw three boxes: beginning, middle and end.
Green flag to start, arrows to move, say to talk, repeat for patterns.
Show your story to the class and tell them about it.
The fox says “Hello!”, hops 3 times to the right (up, down, right), collects the gem, then says “The end!”.
A whole story with talking, hopping and treasure!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
